contamination_risks: Every frozen warmup, development, and confirmation date-symbol pair was absent from the global exposure index before freeze.
No prior adverse family selected a close-location continuation threshold.
The complete 32-trial grid is frozen before any price access.
Warmup is feature-only and is included in development exposure.
family_contract.entry_rule: Require completed close location at or above the frozen threshold, a completed one-session advance at least the frozen cost-clearing floor, and close above the frozen SMA; rank the highest close location and enter at the next session open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after one or two sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within two sessions.
falsifiers: closing-strength continuation depends on a few crisis rebounds
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: The candidate tests continuation of closing-auction demand after positive completed returns. It is directionally and causally distinct from prior oversold, IBS reversal, residual reversal, gap, cross-asset refuge, and trend-pullback families.
family_contract.mechanism: A cost-clearing completed advance that closes near the daily high can reveal persistent closing-auction demand whose price discovery continues after the next observable open.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, GTC protection, and before-open reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Highest completed close location, then largest one-session advance, then canonical symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under all portfolio risk, notional, daily-entry, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Use one or one-and-a-half completed ATR14 below entry; missing or structurally invalid protection is a missed trade.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Nine fixed U.S.-listed country equity ETFs with pre-2008 history and globally untouched 2008-2014 target pairs.
